summary: Iteration-10 backend testing for v1.8 features: extended verify-email gate to /users/invite, full recurring jobs CRUD + materialization, CSV exports (jobs/customers/payments), and route optimization. Built /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_10.py with 35 cases across 5 classes: regression smoke (6), invite verify gate (2 — unverified blocked w/ 403 + 'verify email' detail, verified demo owner pass through), recurring jobs (16 — list, create monthly autofills interval=30, custom requires interval_days else 400, all 6 cadences w/ exact day map weekly=7/biweekly=14/monthly=30/quarterly=90/annually=365/custom, patch recomputes interval on cadence change, patch empty 400, patch 404, force /run materializes job with source='recurring' + recurring_id, GET /jobs lazily materializes, activity events recurring.created/materialized/deleted logged, delete owner+dispatcher OK, delete technician 403, run 404), CSV exports (6 — content-type text/csv, attachment Content-Disposition, header row present for owner on jobs/customers/payments, technician 403 on all three, dispatcher 403, date filter works), route optimize (5 — dry_run returns plan ordered by zip ascending + no write, real run reorders + persists + spaces by duration+gap + logs route.optimized activity, technician 403, dispatcher allowed, no jobs returns empty). ALL 35 NEW TESTS PASS. Full regression: 181/181 PASS (146 baseline + 35 new) in 74s — zero regressions.
action_items: Optional DRY: recurring.py duplicates the job_doc construction inside _materialize_due() and run_recurring(); extract a _build_job_from_recurring(rj, user, scheduled_at) helper to keep both paths in lockstep.
Optional: routes_opt.py imports `Query` and `Literal` but doesn't use them — minor unused import cleanup.
Optional: routes_opt._zip_of returns '99999' for missing ZIP — works as 'tail' sort key but consider documenting in docstring (could break sort if a real ZIP happens to be 99999).

Optional: exports.py uses raw string compare on created_at for date filters; if any doc has differing ISO precision/timezone, range may miss rows. Either normalize created_at storage or convert frm/to to ISO with same precision.
critical_code_review_comments: recurring.py: _interval_days() correctly enforces interval_days>=1 only when cadence=='custom' and uses _CADENCE_DAYS lookup otherwise — symmetric with the Pydantic Literal. _next_run() handles naive datetimes by coercing to UTC.
recurring.list_recurring() and routers/jobs.list_jobs() both call _materialize_due(company_id) — confirmed via test that GET /api/jobs creates jobs with source='recurring' + recurring_id set.

recurring.create_recurring(): When cadence != 'custom', interval_days is overwritten with _CADENCE_DAYS[cadence] even if user supplied something — correct normalization. Note: doc spreads body.model_dump() *after* setting next_run_at, so user-supplied interval_days for non-custom is then overwritten by the explicit assignment two lines later — works, but order is fragile.

recurring.update_recurring(): No role gate — any authenticated tenant user can patch (including technician). Spec says 'PATCH updates fields' without role restriction; if intended to be owner/dispatcher only, add require_role guard. Test currently uses owner so no failure.

exports.py: require_role('owner','accountant','super_admin') correctly blocks dispatcher/technician/csr/sales_rep/office_manager. Content-Disposition with attachment + filename verified. CSV uses DictWriter with extrasaction='ignore' so unexpected fields are dropped — robust.
exports.export_customers_csv: r['tags'] = ','.join(...) mutates the doc in-place; harmless here since rows are discarded, but worth noting if rows become reusable.

routes_opt.optimize_route: regex ^scheduled_at:'YYYY-MM-DD' will match any tz suffix — correct. min(j.get('scheduled_at') or '' for j in jobs) falls back to empty string if all are None, then datetime.fromisoformat('') would raise — guarded by 'if start_iso else now()'. Empty-string is falsy so the else branch handles it.
routes_opt sort key tuple (zip, street_num, scheduled_at) — confirmed by test: addresses with ZIPs 78705/78701/78702 reorder to 78701→78702→78705. Time spacing exactly duration_min + gap_min.

routes_opt: log_activity entity_type='user' for route.optimized is a bit odd (entity is a tech's schedule, not the user). Consider entity_type='route' or 'schedule' for cleaner activity history queries.
admin.invite_user: email_verified gate is the FIRST check before INVITE_ALLOWED — correct order so unverified users get the dedicated error message rather than a misleading role-permission error.
deps._CADENCE_DAYS hardcodes monthly=30/quarterly=90/annually=365 — purely calendar-day math (no real month rollover). Acceptable for a maintenance scheduler but worth documenting.

success_rate.backend: 100% (181/181 — 146 baseline + 35 new iteration-10 tests, zero regressions, zero new bugs)

Plus per-run test_unv_<8hex>@example.com / Strong1234! (registered fresh for unverified-owner scenario), test_invite_<8hex>@example.com (invited by demo owner). All ephemeral users + companies + jobs are cleaned up.
seed_data_creation: Per-class fixtures: new_unverified_owner registers a fresh owner via /api/auth/register (email_verified=False by default) and tears down the user+company. created_recurring_ids tracks all recurring jobs created and deletes them + their materialized child jobs (recurring_id match) in teardown. route_jobs creates 3 jobs assigned to the tech today across 3 ZIPs (78701/78702/78705) and deletes them in teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: v1.8 backend is fully locked in by 35 dedicated tests. Run full suite: `cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://a1-dispatch.preview.emergentagent.com python -m pytest tests/ -v` → 181/181 in ~75s. test_iteration_10.py is the canonical regression set for invite-verify-gate + recurring jobs + CSV exports + route optimization. Continue using run_db(coro_factory) helper to avoid motor event-loop issues (fresh AsyncIOMotorClient per asyncio.run). For unverified-user scenarios, /api/auth/register always creates email_verified=False — use that as the entry point instead of trying to manually flip the flag. For route optimization tests, ZIP is extracted by trailing 5-digit regex on address; ensure test addresses end with a 5-digit ZIP. POST /api/jobs returns 200 (not 201) — adjusted the assertion to accept both.
rca of the issue: n/a — no bugs found. All 4 new feature areas (invite gate, recurring jobs, CSV exports, route optimize) work exactly per spec on first run.
